description: Adds a property to Search Console. This does NOT verify ownership: unless the credential already owns the domain, the property lands as siteUnverifiedUser and every data call for it returns 403. To actually get a working property, use setup_site, which does this in the right order — get_verification_token, then the DNS record or HTML file, then verify_site, then this.

site_url.description: The property to create: "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://example.com/". Required — this one does not fall back to GSC_SITE_URL, because the property being created is by definition not the one you are already working with.

name: add_site
title: Add a property
